title: Structural and Mechanistic Characterization of AprL
summary: Doctoral research on AprL, a PLP-dependent aminotransferase in apramycin biosynthesis relevant to antimicrobial resistance. Combines enzyme kinetics, X-ray crystallography, and computational workflows (molecular docking, MD, MM/GBSA) to elucidate catalytic mechanism and substrate specificity.

title: N-Linked Glycan Structural Characterization by LC-IM-MS
summary: Analytical method development for glycomics, including porous graphitic carbon (PGC) chromatography optimization, ion mobility-mass spectrometry structural characterization of glycan isomers, and reproducible storage protocols for released N-linked glycans.
image_alt: Glycomics LC-IM-MS research project placeholder image

title: Laboratory Automation for Biotherapeutic Manufacturing
summary: Co-op work with the API CEAS Automation team at Johnson & Johnson, Spring House, developing robotic workcell control logic and autonomous transport systems, including a 2D barcode reader workflow and a small-volume pH measurement method.
